ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface area with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white mottling and small focal spots concentrated around the median notch and sparsely scattered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate internal angle of 50-60 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels. Right lobe exhibits significantly more jagged and pronounced peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature extending from the notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) densely packed on the right fluke tip and sparsely distributed on the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the central-right ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (acorn barnacles) along the distal end and trailing edge of the right lobe, creating an irregular structural profile.
